goals: Verify that find_data successfully retrieves the correct record when the search value exists in the sheet.
Verify that find_data returns None when the search value does not exist in the sheet.
activities: Set up a mock Google Sheets client and sheet with predefined records
Call find_data with the mock sheet and an existing search value
Verify that the returned result is not None
Verify that the name in the returned result matches the search value
Set up a mock Google Sheets client and sheet with predefined records
Call find_data with the mock sheet and a non-existing search value
Verify that the returned result is None
